correctness.rationale: For y²+y=x⁹+omega over F4 (omega²+omega+1=0), odd sole pole of degree 9 gives genus (9−1)/2=4, affine derivative in y=1 and one rational infinity point. For all x in F64, x⁹ lies in F8, so absolute trace F64/F2 of x⁹=0, while trace of omega=1 (three-fold F4/F2 trace). Therefore no affine F64 points, N3=1, and same trace over F4 gives N1=1; B3=(N3−N1)/3=0. The universal assertion uses Weil N_r >=4^r+1−8*2^r, and all proper divisors d<=r/2 with N_d bounded by 2^r+1+8*2^(r/2), at most r/2 such d. This is <=49r/32 *2^r for r>=4. Since 2^r−8>49r/32 for every r>=4 by induction, N_r exceeds sum proper N_d and thus r B_r>0. Weil equality at r=3 forces all Frobenius eigenvalues cubed equal 8; N1 fixes multiplicities 4,2,2 among 2,2zeta,2zeta², yielding P(T)=(1−2T)^4(1+2T+4T²)^2 and B1=1,B2=4,B3=0,B4=54. Independently recomputed all shown counts; finite tests are not an all-r proof.
